description: All-time downloads by listener platform, podcast app, country, or region within a country, for a whole podcast or, with episode, for one episode, most downloads first. These are the numbers on the Fireside dashboard's Platforms, Apps and Countries pages. Each row has name, downloads and percent_of_total; meta.total_downloads counts every download, including ones without a recorded name. The totals cover all time and cannot be limited to a date range. Needs a Fireside plan with Advanced Metrics.

app.description: With by platforms only: one app, named exactly as by apps lists it, to break it down by platform.

by.description: platforms (iOS, Android and so on), apps, countries, or regions (states or provinces) of one country.

country.description: Required with by regions, and only used there: a country, named exactly as by countries lists it.

episode.description: Episode token (UUID) or slug, as shown by fireside_list_episodes. Leave out for the whole podcast.

platform.description: With by apps only: one platform, named exactly as by platforms lists it, to list the apps used on it.

podcast.description: Podcast token (UUID) or slug, as shown by fireside_list_podcasts. Required unless FIRESIDE_PODCAST is configured.

name: fireside_get_download_breakdown
title: Get downloads by platform, app or location
